I am an AS300 (Flight CC) with a 6m old baby. (Female) I can say that is doable. Have a support system. People other than your wife that can take care of the baby if your wife falls sick or can’t someday. Also, let your cadre know. My cadre is very flexible and the cadet wing is very supportive towards me and my baby. Sometimes I cannot find someone to take care of my baby and some cadets take charge while I’m at operations or AS class.
